hostedMcp.authentication: OAuth for interactive Cursor, Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, OpenClaw, and Hermes connections; x-api-key via MERMAIL_API_KEY only for CLI, headless jobs, and limited fallbacks; Agent Wallet and x402 require OAuth

platforms.codex: native MCP OAuth; env_http_headers via .codex-plugin/mcp.json is a limited fallback
platforms.claudeCode: native MCP OAuth at user scope; x-api-key header mapping is a limited fallback
platforms.cursor: remote MCP OAuth; x-api-key header mapping is a limited fallback
